map.输入光功率 P 与波长 λ，工具按 N=P·λ/(hc) 计算每秒到达的光子数（: Enter the optical power P and wavelength lambda; the tool computes the number of photons arriving per second as N = P*lambda/(hc) (photon flux), making it easy to compare the per-photon flux of different wavelength sources for optical detection and quantum source estimates.
map.输入光功率 P 与波长 λ，求光子通量。: Enter optical power P and wavelength lambda to get the photon flux.
map.给定功率的光子数率。: Photon rate at a given power.
map.光通信/光伏光子计数。: Photon counting for optical communications and photovoltaics.
map.：N=Pλ/(hc)=1×5e-7/1.986e-25=2.52e18 个光子/: N = P*lambda/(hc) = 1 x 5e-7/1.986e-25 = 2.52e18 photons per second.
map.：波长加倍 → N 加倍=5.04e18/s（每光子能量减半）。: Doubling the wavelength doubles N to 5.04e18 per second (the energy per photon halves).

map.功率固定为何波长长通量高？: With power fixed, why does a longer wavelength give a higher flux?
map.每光子能量随波长增大而减小，故同功率光子数更多。: The energy per photon decreases as the wavelength grows, so the same power yields more photons.
map.与光强关系？: What is the relation to light intensity?
map.光强=单位面积功率，乘以面积得总光子数率。: Light intensity is power per unit area; multiply by the area to get the total photon rate.
